name: ego.-START
description: A state-funded grant program in Saxony-Anhalt providing non-repayable support for personnel and operational costs for technology-based startups during the pre-launch phase.

name: ego.-Gründungstransfer
description: A specialized funding stream designed to facilitate the transfer of research results from universities into market-ready companies in Saxony-Anhalt.

name: ego.-INKUBATOR
description: An incubator program focused on supporting the development of innovative startups originating from Saxony-Anhalt's academic institutions.

name: MBG Silent and Open Participations
description: Provides equity-substitute financing through silent or open participations ranging from 25,000 to 2.5 million euros for startups and growth-stage companies.

name: Technology Start-up Grant (Saxony)
description: A grant program for science-based startups in Saxony to support the establishment of innovative companies in promising technology sectors.

name: GuW-BW Start-up and Growth Financing
description: This program provides interest-subsidized loans to support business start-ups, acquisitions, and expansion projects for companies and freelancers in Baden-Württemberg.

name: Start-up BW Pre-Seed
description: A financial support program for innovative, growth-focused startups in Baden-Württemberg that offers interest-free funding with potential for equity conversion.

name: Start-up BW Venture
description: A co-investment fund designed to support venture capitalists investing in local Baden-Württemberg startups.

name: ESA BIC BW Convertible Loan
description: An investment program for innovative startups in Baden-Württemberg providing convertible loans of up to 200,000 Euro.
